products.blurb: Buildable panda-shaped house with animal figures. One of the most giftable Minecraft LEGO sets.

products.name: LEGO Minecraft The Fox Lodge
products.blurb: Fox-shaped lodge set with drowned zombie and animal figures. Compact and affordable.
products.blurb_es: Set de la cabaña del zorro con zombi ahogado y figuras de animales. Compacto y asequible.
